pages.heading: Elephant
pages.body: Savannas. Tame calves or non-tusked adults with Acacia Blossoms; wild tusked adults cannot be tamed. Ride a tame elephant and add a chest for storage;

pages.heading: Elephant (cont.)
pages.body: sneak to open it. Carpets decorate it and shears remove fittings. Tamed tusked elephants can charge when fed wheat while ridden. Breed tame elephants with blossoms.
